hero_eyebrow: UPVC Spraying Specialists — Interior & Exterior Painting
hero_subhead: From interior redecoration to full UPVC spraying — we transform properties across Manchester with precision and care.
services_subhead: We specialise in interior decoration, exterior painting, UPVC restoration and specialist finishes for residential and commercial properties.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Full interior redecoration including walls, woodwork and ceilings. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints to deliver a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint work for walls, fascias and soffits. We use top-grade exterior paints to protect your property for years to come.

services.title: UPVC Spraying & Restoration
services.desc: Specialist UPVC spraying to restore faded windows, doors and cladding to like-new condition without costly replacement. Durable, colour-matched finish.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Rapid turnaround decoration for shops, offices and industrial units. We work flexibly around your business hours to minimise disruption.

services.title: Feature Walls & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Create impact with feature walls, textured finishes and bespoke colour schemes. We help you realise the look you want.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Expert painting of doors, skirting boards, windows and bespoke joinery. Smooth, durable finishes that enhance any interior.

about_pullquote: We turn tired rooms into spaces people love living in.
about_para_1: Worsley Decorating & UPVC Spraying Ltd has been transforming homes and businesses across Manchester for over 12 years. We started with a simple mission: deliver professional, reliable decorating work at fair prices. Today, we've completed over 2,000 projects — from single-room redecorations to full commercial refurbishments — and built a reputation for meticulous preparation and quality finishes.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we show up on time, listen to what you want, and take pride in every detail. We specialise in UPVC spraying, which lets homeowners refresh their windows and doors without the cost and hassle of replacement. Whether it's a quick refresh or a complex project, we bring the same professionalism and care.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Worsley Decorating

reviews.text: Had the whole house redecorated and it looks immaculate. The lads were tidy, professional and finished on time. Colour matching on the skirting boards was perfect. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Got our UPVC windows and doors sprayed instead of replacing them. Saved us thousands and they look brand new. The team explained everything clearly and the finish is flawless. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Caroline M.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. They took time preparing the walls properly, didn't rush the job, and the paint work is excellent. Fair price too. Will be using them again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Michael P.
